Source src/experiments/star-field/engine/frame/fx.ts
UX surface Boot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

_camScratch

Module scratch vector — updateFx drops the camera position into each gas plane's parent-local frame once per frame; reusing one vector keeps the per-frame path allocation-free.

solarWindAt

Solar-wind level — the shared activity signal every wind-touched system reads from s.solarWind/s.fxTime: a slow BASE+WAVE swell (the ~11-year-style activity cycle compressed to scene seconds) plus sharp storm spikes from two detuned sines raised to a high power — rare, brief, bright gusts that make auroras ignite and flares leap.

  • @param t Scene seconds.
  • @returns Activity level (0 quiet … ~1.5 storm).

updateFx

Ambient life — the small "alive" behaviors on top of the static chart: pulse bodies (variable stars, pulsars, flaring cores) breathe via a sine scale oscillation; cycle bodies (Earth's glaciation) lerp the surface tint between the neutral white and the ice-age palette.

  • @param s Engine state.

gasI

Streaming gas — each tail's tessellated plane is a CYLINDRICAL BILLBOARD: it rolls about its streak axis so the broad side faces the camera (a plane edge-on is a hairline, never a polygonal shell), while the vertex-color envelope keeps every quad edge at alpha 0 and the seamless filament map scrolls offset.x underneath so gas visibly streams anti-sunward. The roll solves θ = atan2(−uy, lz) in the tail-parent frame after rotating the dust tilt back out — the plane's +z normal then points at the camera; a slow wobble overlays it for turbulent shimmer, and a detuned sine flickers opacity like plasma gusts. The plane shadows the base tail's length each frame and scales its width on y only (z stays 1 — it is a surface, not a shell).

cam

Camera roll — the camera position drops into each plane's parent-local frame (+x anti-sunward), the dust tilt is rotated back out of the offset so the roll axis is the streak's own x, and the remaining transverse angle solves θ = atan2(−uy, lz) (normal +z → (0,−sinθ,cosθ) ∥ (uy,lz)). A lazy module scratch vector keeps this allocation-free; without a camera/parent the planes keep their built orientation plus the wobble.
